tree_base: main merged at the start of the packet
question: Publish the per-barrel accuracy 00A08460 reads so the model replaces its class stand-in, and measure IJN01 before and after on one build.
answer: The accuracy is not stored on any weapon record. 00A093D7 reads the bullet class record out of the 48h-stride barrel entry's +34h, 00A093DA hands it to 009FE270 as EDX at 00A094E6, and 009FE270 switches on that record's +8h to pick one float out of the 00A371A0 per-mode AI tuning record. The only writer of those floats is 00A335D0, loading the BulletTypeAccuracy section of Scripts\datatables\HighLvlAIGlobals.lua into record offsets 110h-18Ch. So the row owes a SELECTOR, not an accuracy, and the lookup runs per target. Three pieces land together: the gunnery host keeps the sub-type 006E9890 already computed and publishes it on the barrel; ai_tuning_load_00a335d0 fills 110h-18Ch and also 05Ch/060h, because DamageCalcTime was outside the 33-key subset and is the numerator of every barrel's time factor, so turning the model on without it would have answered zero for every pair; and AiWeightModelBinding::barrel_accuracy resolves the target axis it was already being handed and discarding. The target axis is arm 009FE2A2's own shape: PUSH 0Fh the plane base, else PUSH 6 the ship base split by 00827F70, else the fall-through, which the authored Lua comment names Repulore/Kishajora/Nagyhajora/Landfortra.
coverage: complete for 009FE270's dispatch (byte table 009FE6EC and jump table 009FE6C4 read from bytes), for arms 009FE2A2, 009FE313, 009FE384, 009FE3F5, 009FE44A, 009FE465, 009FE480 and 009FE64A, for the twelve bullet-class constructors that store +8h, and for 00827F70. PARTIAL for arm 009FE4F1: the predicates 006E3260, 007B80A0 and 007B80C0 that choose SmallRocket over BigRocket are not read, so the Rocket sub-type 12h is flagged unresolved and its units keep the stand-in rather than scoring at a fabricated zero. 00A08460's attacker-is-type-0Fh branch 00A0861F..00A09222 remains unprojected, as before this packet.

corrections.is: GameAiWeaponFacts::Barrel::bullet_sub_type plus accuracy_resolved. The accuracy is a function of (bullet sub-type, target class group) and cannot be a per-barrel constant.

result: The three pieces are implemented and verified against the listing, and the model is left SWITCHED OFF because switching it on is a measured regression. Three IJN01 runs, one build each. Before (local/acc_ijn01_before.log): served 2450, attackmove 2250, settarget 141, fallback 59, scored 465500, model_runs 0; this reproduces local/tw_ijn01.log exactly on a tree with main merged, so the pair is a clean A/B. With the model on (local/acc_ijn01_after.log): model_runs 465500, class_stand_ins 0, complete_rows 321 of 321, so the plumbing works - but the model answers zero for 460600 candidates, exactly the fort_targets count, scored collapses to 4900, and attackmove and settarget both go to 0 with all 2450 served members taking the fallback moveto. The AI stops attacking. inputs_complete is therefore held false in src/game_hosts_gunnery.cpp, one line. A first reading blamed the target hit points and was REFUTED by a third run (local/acc_ijn01_after2.log) that gated completeness on hit_points > 0: complete_rows stayed 321 and no other number moved, so every row has real health, and the condition was removed rather than left in. The residue is 00A08460's own coverage - its attacker-is-type-0Fh branch 00A0861F..00A09222 is unprojected and entity_is_type and entity_kind are stubs - or authored-zero accuracy for the attackers' actual barrel types against the fall-through group. Which of the two is not settled here.
validation: Build clean at /W4 /WX; both ctest suites pass. Three game runs as above. With inputs_complete false the model never runs, and the only tuning offsets this packet adds (05Ch, 060h, 110h-18Ch) are read by nothing but the model, so main keeps exactly the before behaviour the first run measured.
